units.source_text: 到了贺茂祭及斋院祓禊的时节，

en.t: When the season came for the Kamo Festival and the purification rites of the Saiin,

units.source_text: 朝中上下人等，皆借此名义，馈赠源氏公子种种礼品，为数甚多。

en.t: people high and low at court all used the occasion as a pretext to send Prince Genji many kinds of gifts, in very great numbers.

units.source_text: 公子便将此种物品分送一切心目中人。

en.t: The prince then distributed these things among all those who were on his mind.

units.source_text: 就中对末摘花格外体贴入微，

en.t: Among them, he showed especially thoughtful and delicate care toward Suetsumuhana,

units.source_text: 叮咛嘱咐几个心腹人员，派遣仆役前往割除庭中杂草。

en.t: carefully instructing several trusted attendants and sending servants to cut away the weeds in her garden.

units.source_text: 四周太不雅观，又命筑一道板垣，将宅子围起来。

en.t: Since the surroundings looked far too unsightly, he also ordered a board fence to be built around the house.

units.source_text: 但恐外间谣传，说源氏公子如此这般地找到了一个女人，

en.t: But he feared that rumors would spread outside, saying that Prince Genji had found himself a woman in such a manner,
which would be a matter damaging to his dignity.

units.source_text: 因此自己不去访问，只是送去的信，写得非常详细周至。

en.t: For that reason he did not visit her himself, but the letters he sent were written with great detail and consideration.

units.source_text: 信中有言：“正在二条院附近修筑房屋，

en.t: In one letter he wrote, "A residence is now being built near Nijo Palace,
and in time I will bring you there to live.

units.source_text: 先物色几个优秀女童供你使唤。”

en.t: First I will look for several capable young maidservants to attend you."

units.source_text: 竟连侍女之事也都操心关怀。

en.t: He even took thought and care over matters concerning her attendants.

units.source_text: 因此住在那荒草丛中的人，喜不自胜，

en.t: Therefore the lady living amid those overgrown weeds was overjoyed beyond restraint,

units.source_text: 众侍女都仰望长空，向二条院方向合掌礼拜。

en.t: and all her maidservants looked up at the wide sky and bowed with hands joined toward Nijo Palace.
